jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Performance and Optimisation
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

As Performance and Optimization Manager, you will drive commercial performance across the fleet by transforming complex data into strategic insights and actionable recommendations.

Working closely with Deployment, Revenue Management, Commercial Planning and Finance teams, you will assess the commercial and financial effectiveness of itineraries and deployment strategies, identifying opportunities to maximize revenue, profitability and guest value.
Through advanced analytics and performance evaluation, you will support critical business decisions, uncover growth opportunities and contribute to the continuous optimization of MSC Cruises' commercial strategy in a dynamic and competitive global environment.

Your Impact

- Develop driver-based performance and economic models linking deployment and itinerary choices to revenue potential, operating costs, fuel and emissions, port costs, asset utilization and overall contribution.

- Monitor performance by ship, itinerary, deployment pattern, region and season, using consistent and governed KPIs.

- Identify performance gaps, root causes and quantified optimization opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations for deployment and itinerary decisions.

- Develop forward-looking indicators and early-warning mechanisms to identify profitability risks, capacity imbalances and optimization opportunities before they materialize.

- Support scenario evaluation and post-implementation reviews comparing expected vs. realized economic impact and identifying lessons for future deployment decisions.

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Management to ensure consistency of assumptions, metric definitions, attribution methodology and benefit validation.

- Benchmark itinerary and deployment performance across ships, regions and seasons, identifying scalable best practices and structural improvement opportunities.

- Maintain a quantified deployment optimization opportunity pipeline, tracking expected value, ownership, implementation and realized benefits.

- Decision rights: owns KPI definitions and analytical standards; recommends priorities and validates benefits with Finance.

- Core outputs: scorecard, opportunity pipeline, root-cause analyses, test plans, benchmarks and benefit tracking.

- Success measures: incremental revenue or margin, conversion and spend improvement, forecast accuracy, action closure and adoption.

Your Journey so far

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Hospitality, Marketing or related field.

- 5-8 years of relevant commercial analytics, revenue management, onboard revenue, performance improvement

- Strong Power BI experience

- Strong understanding of guest behavior, revenue drivers, conversion, yield and service profitability.

- Proven ability to turn analysis into interventions and validate financial impact.

- Fluent English.

Your Essentials

- Advanced SQL, business intelligence, statistical analysis or comparable tools.

- Python advantageous.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

- Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.

- Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.

- Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.

- Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.

- Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

- Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.

Data Analysis and Insights. Main activities include:

- QA data to ensure accuracy

- Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted

- Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed

- Make business recommendations based on the data findings

- Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights

Analysis Distribution. Main activities include:

- Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution

- Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story

- Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Analytical Innovation. Main activities include:

- Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes

- Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques

Your Journey so far

- Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment

- Experience with “big data” environments and tool

- Experience data and analytics

- Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

- Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT

Your Essentials

- Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.

- Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Categoria è il proprietario di business globale per la categoria Orologi & Gioielli attraverso MSC Crociere e Explora Viaggi.

Il ruolo è responsabile per la definizione e l'esecuzione della strategia di categoria globale, la guida delle prestazioni commerciali, lo sviluppo di un assortimento di classe mondiale, e la costruzione di partnership a lungo termine con orologi e maison di gioielli leader.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, la pianificazione e il budget e la supply chain, questo ruolo assicura che la categoria offra esperienze eccezionali agli ospiti, massimizzando le vendite, la redditività e l'equità del marchio in tutte le navi.

La posizione combina la gestione strategica delle categorie con una forte leadership commerciale per elevare continuamente l'offerta di vendita a bordo sia in ambienti contemporanei che di lusso.

Il tuo impatto

Strategia di categoria & Proprietà aziendale

- Possedere la strategia globale di categoria Orologi & Gioielli attraverso MSC Crociere e Explora Viaggi.

- Definire la visione di categoria a lungo termine allineato con gli obiettivi commerciali e il posizionamento di ogni marchio di crociera.

- Identificare tendenze emergenti, opportunità di mercato e aspettative degli ospiti per evolvere continuamente la categoria.

- Costruire un portafoglio equilibrato tra gioielli pregiati, gioielli di moda, orologi di lusso, orologi contemporanei e collezioni esclusive.

- Sviluppare le roadmap di categoria che supportano l'espansione futura della flotta, i nuovi concetti e le nuove presentazioni del marchio.

Prestazioni commerciali

- Fornire obiettivi di vendita di categoria, margine lordo e redditività.

- Monitorare le prestazioni della categoria attraverso l'analisi KPI, identificare le opportunità e le azioni correttive.

- Ottimizzare mix di prodotti, architettura dei prezzi, attività promozionali e produttività dell'inventario.

- Piombo di pianificazione e assortimento in collaborazione con i team di pianificazione e gestione ordini della domanda.

- Miglioramento continuo della produttività per SKU, per marca, per boutique e per nave.

Sviluppo del prodotto e gestione dell'assortimento

- Curati assortiti convincenti adattati a demografie ospiti, regioni, itinerari e profili delle navi.

- Sviluppare prodotti esclusivi, capsule collection ed edizioni solo crociere con partner strategici.

- Gestisci il ciclo di vita completo del prodotto dalla selezione e dall'imbarco al phase-out.

- Assicurarsi che l'assortimento rifletta le tendenze del mercato mantenendo un'architettura coerente del marchio.

- Equilibrio innovazione con dimostrati interpreti commerciali.

Partnership di brand

- Sviluppare e gestire le relazioni con marchi di orologi e gioielli globali.

- I principali negoziati commerciali tra cui i termini di negoziazione, le esclusioni, i lanci di prodotto e i piani di business congiunti.

- Identificare e a bordo nuovi marchi allineati con la strategia di vendita al dettaglio del Gruppo.

- Coordinate recensioni sulle prestazioni dei fornitori e continue iniziative di sviluppo aziendale.

- Rappresentante MSC Gruppo durante eventi di settore, fiere e riunioni di partner.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Definire le linee guida di merchandising specifiche per la categoria Orologi & Gioielli.

- Collabora con Visual Merchandising per creare esperienze boutique premium che migliorano la conversione e la narrazione.

- Supporta nuove costruzioni, ristrutturazioni e riprogetti boutique da una prospettiva di categoria.

- Assicurare le collezioni sono presentate secondo gli standard di lusso del marchio e l'eccellenza visiva.

- Partner con i team di bordo per migliorare continuamente l'esecuzione della categoria.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Collabora a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale a bordo.

- Lavorare con la pianificazione e la gestione degli ordini per garantire la disponibilità ottimale dell'inventario, riducendo al minimo lo stock in eccesso.

- Partner con Performance per monitorare la redditività della categoria e le prestazioni di investimento.

- Interfaccia con dipartimenti e stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire un coordinamento ottimale, comunicazione, allineamento ed esecuzione in tutta l'organizzazione.

Leadership

- Guidare e sviluppare il team di merchandising Orologi & Gioielli.

- Promuovere una cultura dell'innovazione, della responsabilità, della collaborazione e dell'eccellenza commerciale.

- Allena i membri del team e supporta la pianificazione della successione.

- Incoraggia il processo decisionale basato sui dati mantenendo un forte focus del cliente e del marchio.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 10+ anni di esperienza in orologi di lusso e/o merchandising di gioielli.

- Un successo consolidato che gestisce le categorie di prodotti internazionali all'interno di ambienti di lusso retail, travel retail o omnichannel.

- Forte esperienza nella pianificazione di assortimento, acquisto, negoziazione di fornitori e gestione di categoria.

- Esperienza di lavoro con marchi di orologi e gioielli riconosciuti a livello internazionale.

- L'esperienza in ambienti di vendita al dettaglio di lusso o di viaggio è altamente auspicabile

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione di orologi di lusso e mercati di gioielli, tendenze e comportamento dei consumatori.

- Forte acume commerciale e finanziario con eccellenti capacità analitiche.

- Capacità comprovata di negoziare e costruire partnership strategiche a lungo termine.

- Ottima comprensione dei principi di merchandising, architettura assortimento e ottimizzazione inventario.

- Forte gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative.

- Capacità di lavorare in ambienti multiculturali e internazionali.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

- Passione per la vendita al dettaglio di lusso e la fornitura di esperienze ospiti eccezionali.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Kategorie Strategie & Business Ownership

- Besitzen Sie die globale Watches & Jewelry-Kategoriestrategie für MSC Cruises und Explora Journeys.

- Führen Sie die Prognose- und Sortimentsplanung in Zusammenarbeit mit Demand Planning und Order Management Teams.

- Steigern Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktivität pro SKU, pro Marke, pro Boutique und pro Schiff.

- Koordinieren Sie die Leistungsüberprüfungen von Lieferanten und kontinuierliche Geschäftsentwicklungsinitiativen.

- Vertretung MSC Gruppe bei Branchenveranstaltungen, Messen und Partnertreffen.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Kollektionen nach Luxusmarkenstandards und visueller Exzellenz präsentiert werden.

- Partnerschaft mit Onboard-Teams zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kategorieausführung.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Planung und Auftragsverwaltung zusammen, um eine optimale Bestandsverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig den Überbestand zu minimieren.

- Partnerschaft mit Performance zur Überwachung der Kategorie Rentabilität und Investitionsperformance.

jobs.description:

Your Purpose

MSC Cruise Division is strengthening its Talent Acquisition capability to support a broad and evolving portfolio of recruitment needs across our brands.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Geneva team for a temporary six months assignment. Working closely with Talent Acquisition colleagues, HR Business Partners and hiring managers, you will translate business needs into focused sourcing strategies, identify and engage relevant talent, and build qualified pipelines for current and future hiring requirements.

This is a hands-on, market-facing role for someone who enjoys understanding the business, conducting proactive searches and creating momentum across multiple assignments. The portfolio may include corporate, operational, specialist, management and selected senior leadership positions across different brands, functions and geographies.

What matters most is your ability to source proactively, communicate credibly with candidates and stakeholders, work with pace and take ownership of your delivery.

Your Impact

- Partner with hiring managers and HR team to understand staffing needs and role requirements.

- Source, screen, interview and assess candidates using a variety of channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, talent pools and direct search methodologies.

- Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across assigned functions, from role briefing and sourcing strategy definition through candidate selection, offer and onboarding handover.

- Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment activity and reporting within the ATS, ensuring data integrity and compliance.

- Deliver a best-in-class candidate experience by maintaining clear communication, timely feedback and a professional representation of the MSC Cruises employer brand.

- Collaborate with internal teams to support employer branding initiatives and strengthen MSC Cruises' presence in the talent market.

- Stay up to date on hiring trends, AI and market intelligence, labor market conditions, and hiring best practices.

Your Journey so far

- 5 years of experience in agency recruitment, talent sourcing, talent research, talent acquisition, or executive search.

- A proven ability to identify, approach and qualify for passive candidates, including hard-to-fill positions.

- Business curiosity and the ability to understand a position beyond its job description, including its purpose, operating context, stakeholders, and expected impact.

- Demonstrated the ability to manage multiple recruitment projects while maintaining attention to details and quality in delivery.

- Proven track record of implementing effective sourcing strategies and building strong relationships with HR partners and hiring managers.

- Strong candidate engagement skills and the ability to communicate opportunities in a clear, credible, and compelling manner.

Your Essentials

- Full professional fluency in English is mandatory. French or Italian would be an advantage.

- Practical experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and an Applicant Tracking System or recruitment CRM. Experience with Phenom and/or SuccessFactors are an advantage.

- Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage several assignments simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

- High levels of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgement when managing confidential candidate and business information.

- Eligibility to work in Switzerland for the full duration of the assignment.

- Availability to complete a full-time temporary assignment of six months.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il portafoglio può includere posizioni di leadership aziendali, operative, specialistiche, manageriali e selezionate in diversi marchi, funzioni e geografie.

- Gestire il ciclo di vita di reclutamento completo attraverso le funzioni assegnate, dal briefing di ruolo e dalla definizione di strategia di sourcing attraverso la selezione dei candidati, l'offerta e la consegna onboarding.

- Offrire una migliore esperienza di candidato mantenendo una comunicazione chiara, feedback tempestivo e una rappresentanza professionale del marchio datore di lavoro MSC Crociere.

- Provato record di tracciamento di implementare efficaci strategie di approvvigionamento e la costruzione di forti relazioni con i partner HR e i manager di assunzione.

- Forte capacità di coinvolgimento dei candidati e la capacità di comunicare opportunità in modo chiaro, credibile e convincente.

I tuoi essenziali

- È obbligatoria la completa fluidità professionale in inglese. Francese o italiano sarebbe un vantaggio.

- Esperienza pratica utilizzando LinkedIn Recruiter e un sistema di monitoraggio applicabile o reclutamento CRM. Esperienza con Phenom e/o SuccessFactors sono un vantaggio.

- Forte capacità organizzative e di priorità, con la capacità di gestire più assegnazioni contemporaneamente mantenendo l'attenzione ai dettagli.

- Alti livelli di discrezione, professionalità e giudizio sonoro quando gestiscono i candidati confidenziali e le informazioni aziendali.

- Ammissibilità a lavorare in Svizzera per tutta la durata dell'assegnazione.

- Disponibilità per completare un incarico temporaneo a tempo pieno di sei mesi.

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics

- Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.

- Provide regular performance analysis by:

- Ship

- Boutique

- Category

- Brand

- SK

- Itinerary

- Guest segment

- Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.

- Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.

KPI Framework & Reporting

- Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:

- Sales performance

- Conversion rate

- Average Transaction Value (ATV)

- Units Per Transaction (UPT)

- Sales per square meter / selling space

- Sell-through

- Gross margin

- Inventory productivity

- Stock turn

- Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.

- Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Demand & Inventory Analytics

- Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.

- Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.

- Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.

- Provide recommendations for:

- Allocation

- Replenishment

- Stock balancing

- Inventory optimization

- Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.

Commercial Control & Profitability

- Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.

- Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.

- Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.

- Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.

- Evaluate profitability by:

- Product

Assortment & Category Insights

- Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.

- Analyze:

- Product productivity

- SKU contribution

- Collection performance

- Brand performance

- Price architecture

- Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.

- Monitor inventory health across the fleet.

- Identify:

- Overstock situations

- Stock shortages

- Obsolete inventory

- Low productivity products

- Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.

- Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.

Data Management & Tools

- Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.

- Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.

- Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with:

- Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics

- Category Managers

- Retail Operations

- Merchandise Planning

- Finance

- Supply Chain

- IT / Digital teams

- Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions

Your Journey so far

- 5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.

- Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.

- Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.

- Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.

- Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

- Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.

- Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

- Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).

- Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.

- Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.

- Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Retail Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.

The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

Your Impact

Retail Activation Strategy

- Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.

- Balance major events with agile onboard activations.

- Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.

Event & Experience Management

- Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.

- Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.

- Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.

- Measure event performance and implement improvements.

Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation

- Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.

- Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.

- Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.

- Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.

VIP & Client Engagement

- Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.

- Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.

- Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.

- Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.

Local & Destination Based Activations

- Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.

- Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.

- Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.

Brand Partner Collaboration

- Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.

- Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.

- Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.

- Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.

Content & Communication Coordination

- Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.

- Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.

- Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.

Performance Measurement

- Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.

- Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.

- Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.

- Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.

Your Journey so far

- 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.

- Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.

- Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.

- Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.

- Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.

- Excellent project management and event execution skills.

- Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.

- Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.

- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.

Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Das Beste deiner Abenteuer ist das, das du noch nicht gesegelt hast!

Dein Zweck

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, außergewöhnliche private Ziele zu gestalten, in denen Design, Natur und Gastfreundschaft zusammenkommen, um unvergessliche Gästeerlebnisse zu schaffen?

Bringen Sie praktisches Fachwissen in Themenparks, Resorts oder Inselerlebnissen und die analytische Denkweise mit, um komplexe operative Herausforderungen in nahtlose, wirkungsvolle Urlaubsmomente zu verwandeln?

Ihre Wirkung

MSC Cruises sucht einen Senior Director of Product Innovation mit Expertise in den Bereichen Hospitality, F&B und Resortentwicklung. In dieser Rolle definieren Sie die Zukunft der ansprechenden, phantasievollen und operativ machbaren Ziele. Sie kombinieren strategische Erkenntnisse, kreatives Denken und operatives Know-how, um Umgebungen zu entwerfen, die unsere Gäste begeistern.

Sie arbeiten eng mit Marken-, Entwicklungs-, Design-, technischen und operativen Teams zusammen, um komplexe Anforderungen in umsetzbare Pläne zu übersetzen. Mit operativen Erkenntnissen, Branchentrends und Prinzipien der nachhaltigen Entwicklung gestalten Sie Konzepte, die Machbarkeit, Innovation und Gästeerfahrung in Einklang bringen.

Wenn Sie an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Analyse und operativer Führung erfolgreich sind und es genießen, visionäre Konzepte in greifbare, unvergessliche Urlaubserlebnisse zu verwandeln, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.

- Fähigkeit, komplexe betriebliche und technische Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Konzepte zu übersetzen.

- Das Verständnis von Architektur-, Design- oder Ingenieurprinzipien ist ein Plus.

- Hervorragende Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende und multikulturelle Teams zu koordinieren und auszurichten.

- Strategischer Denker mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten; in der Lage, Machbarkeit, operative Auswirkungen und Auswirkungen auf die Gästeerfahrung zu beurteilen.

- Starke Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, komplexe Ideen an Führungskräfte und Führungskräfte zu vermitteln.

- Agiles, anpassungsfähiges und komfortables Arbeiten in einer sich schnell entwickelnden Umgebung.

- Leidenschaft für die Bereitstellung von operativ machbaren, gastorientierten Innovationen.

-
• Fähigkeit, 20-30% der Zeit zu reisen.

-
• fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Plus.

• EU-Pass oder Recht auf Arbeit in der Schweiz.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Votre impact

MSC Cruises est à la recherche d'un directeur principal de l'innovation de produits avec une expertise en hospitalité, F&B et développement de station. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez l'avenir des destinations engageantes, imaginatives et opérationnelles. Vous combinerez une vision stratégique, une pensée créative et une expertise opérationnelle pour concevoir des environnements qui ravissent nos invités.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de marque, de développement, de conception, technique et opérationnelle pour traduire des exigences complexes en plans réalisables. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Diriger l'idée et le développement conceptuel des destinations privées, définir les objectifs, la planification principale, les paramètres opérationnels et les contraintes techniques.

- Mobiliser et harmoniser plusieurs intervenants d'une région à l'autre, en fournissant des conseils sur les priorités, la faisabilité et les objectifs stratégiques.

- Contribuer à l'élaboration de feuilles de route à long terme pour les destinations privées et les expériences de villégiature, en assurant l'alignement avec la vision de la marque et les objectifs de l'expérience des invités.

- Préparer des présentations et des documents convaincants pour communiquer la justification, les exigences opérationnelles et les recommandations aux cadres supérieurs.

- Veiller à ce que tous les concepts proposés respectent les normes en matière de santé, de sécurité, d'environnement et de réglementation.

Vos essentiels

- 10-15 ans d'expérience en conception expérientielle, gestion de destination/resort avec gestion des opérations port/croisement a plus.

- Forte connaissance opérationnelle de la logistique de croisière, du développement hôtelier, des opérations portuaires et des exigences techniques.

- Capacité de traduire des exigences opérationnelles et techniques complexes en concepts clairs et réalisables.

- La compréhension des principes d'architecture, de conception ou d'ingénierie est un atout.

- Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de coordonner et d'harmoniser les équipes interfonctionnelles et multiculturelles.

- Un penseur stratégique possédant de solides compétences analytiques; capable d'évaluer la faisabilité, l'impact opérationnel et les répercussions sur l'expérience des invités.

- Forte capacité de communication et de présentation, capable de transmettre des idées complexes au leadership supérieur et exécutif.

- Travail agile, adaptable et confortable dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

- Passionné de fournir des innovations opérationnelles réalisables et axées sur les clients.

-
• Anglais courant; langues supplémentaires a plus.
